children: Grupo Supervielle reported 3Q26 net income of AR$6.8B, versus AR$13.6B in 2Q26 and a net loss of AR$67.0B in 3Q25. Adjusted net income excluding severance charges was AR$10.7B; net loans rose 1.3% QoQ in real terms.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
3Q26 net income AR$6.8B vs AR$13.6B in 2Q26
Sequential earnings fell; the release attributes pressure to lower net financial income and margin compression.
Adjusted 3Q26 net income AR$10.7B
Excludes extraordinary severance charges, including approximately AR$5.9B in 3Q26; reported and adjusted earnings diverge.
Net loans rose 1.3% QoQ in real terms
Signals resumed lending growth, though September growth of 3.7% was MoM and does not establish a sustained trend.
NPL ratio 5.4%, about 200 bps below industry
Improving credit quality may support future earnings, but commercial portfolio delinquency worsened during the quarter.
Net interest margin fell 430 bps QoQ to 16.0%
Margin compression weighed on earnings; the prior quarter's temporary spread benefits unwound.
CET1 ratio 13.5%, down from 14.2% in 2Q26
Capital declined sequentially as risk-weighted assets increased, while remaining 30 bps above a year earlier.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a transitional earnings update: credit and cost indicators improved, but lower net financial income more than offset those gains. The November 23 Supervielle Day and subsequent results will show whether loan growth and lower costs translate into stronger recurring profitability.
